# Elearning CMS repository instructions

Before performing any repository task—including searching, reviewing, planning,
or generating code—read and follow the complete canonical rules in
`docs/ai/PROJECT_RULES.md`.

Always preserve existing user changes. Never suggest or execute a commit, push,
merge, rebase, tag, release, or pull request as part of an implementation task.
Never expose secrets or production data. Keep changes task-scoped, follow the
Laravel architecture boundaries, and include focused verification guidance.
